# DiagnosticsService

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Diagnostics` · class

```csharp
public sealed class DiagnosticsService
```

Game service for finding out how the game is running, such as its performance and its startup.

## Properties

### StatsOverlayMode

```csharp
public StatsOverlayMode StatsOverlayMode { get; set; }
```

Types: [`StatsOverlayMode`](StatsOverlayMode.md)

Shows or hides the on-screen stats overlay (FPS, frame time, update/draw split between framework and app code), and selects its content and the level of measurement performed by the underlying collector. Defaults to [`StatsOverlayMode.Off`](StatsOverlayMode.md#off); in shipped builds leave it off. [`StatsOverlayMode.FpsOnly`](StatsOverlayMode.md#fpsonly) measures only one timestamp per frame; [`StatsOverlayMode.Detailed`](StatsOverlayMode.md#detailed) activates the full bracket-based timing on every framework call site.

Familiar in spirit to Unreal's `stat unit`, Unity's Diagnostics panel, and Godot's monitor. Collection is fully gated by mode, so the steady-state cost when [`StatsOverlayMode.Off`](StatsOverlayMode.md#off) is a single predictable branch per hook (no Stopwatch reads, no allocations).

## Methods

### MarkStartupMilestone

```csharp
public void MarkStartupMilestone(string name, string? detail = null)
```

Marks a milestone of the game's startup, so startup can be measured the same way in every build, including a published one. It's traced with the time since the process started, and on the web it's also a performance mark, which the page's startup report collects. Only the first mark of each name counts, so a path that runs again can mark freely.

| Parameter | |
|---|---|
| `name` | The milestone, in kebab case, such as `"content-loaded"`. |
| `detail` | Optional context recorded with it, such as the scene shown or the number of assets. |
